ideas.pitch: An edge-AI system processing optical satellite tracking data locally on constrained hardware to predict orbital debris conjunctions in real-time.
ideas.problem_statement: Satellite Systems and Earth Observation tracking challenges
ideas.title: AstroShield: Edge-AI Debris Collision Warning
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features hard engineering in local ML execution on resource-constrained devices, matching winning patterns for complex edge processing.

ideas.pitch: A simulated intermittent communication protocol designed for high-latency, packet-loss-heavy CubeSat downlinks using error-correcting codecs.
ideas.problem_statement: Communication and IoT challenges in space technology
ideas.title: OrbitalLink: Resilient Space-to-Ground LoRa Protocol
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a fundamental space tech bottleneck with a working network simulator and live telemetry demonstration.

ideas.pitch: A robotic navigation script combining ultrasonic telemetry and computer vision to map uneven planetary terrain and identify craters autonomously.
ideas.problem_statement: Robotics and IoT challenges for space exploration
ideas.title: RegolithRover: Autonomous Surface Hazard Mapping
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides an unusual physical and visual build that stands out in a room full of standard web applications.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent telemetry analysis dashboard powered by lightweight language models and time-series anomaly detection algorithms to flag critical life-support failures.
ideas.problem_statement: AI/ML and Data challenges in aerospace systems
ideas.title: CosmoGuard: Spacecraft Telemetry Anomaly Detector
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes advanced multi-agent diagnostic patterns that scored high in recent hackathons, ensuring strong technical appeal to judges.

ideas.pitch: A cryptographic access control system using physical secure elements to prevent unauthorized uplink commands to experimental satellites.
ideas.title: AeroCrypt: Hardware-Secured Ground Station Auth
ideas.why_it_could_win: Integrates hardware security modules with backend validation, mirroring winning anti-counterfeiting and hardware integration designs.
